item.title: Savannah Guthrie’s Mom, Nancy Guthrie, Missing; Sheriff Describes 84-Year-Old’s Home As a “Crime Scene”
item.description: The missing mother of the TODAY anchor is not in good health, and was last seen Saturday night at her Arizona home. The Pima County Sheriff’s Department Monday updated the media, saying that after fruitless searching, “we don’t see this as much as a search mission as a crime scene.”

item.title: Turning Point USA’s “All-American” Halftime Show Is Happening After All
item.description: With less than a week to go before the big event, Turning Point USA has finally announced its headliners for its All-American Halftime Show: Gabby Barrett, Lee Brice, Brantley Gilbert, and Kid Rock.

item.title: A Second Accuser Alleges a “Sexual Encounter” With Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor at Jeffrey Epstein’s Request
item.description: The victim’s lawyer says she was in her 20s when she was “sent by Jeffrey Epstein over to Prince Andrew.”

item.title: How Nicki Minaj Took MAGA by the Hand
item.description: Jarring as the alliance has seemed, it grew from a certain attitudinal resonance between the rapper and the president, each raised in Queens and bearing a sense of persecution, as well as some increasingly overlapping social circles.

item.title: Donald Trump Threatens to Sue Trevor Noah Over Epstein Grammys Joke
item.description: While hosting the Grammys on Sunday, the former Daily Show host made a dig implying that Trump and Bill Clinton had hung out on Jeffrey Epstein’s notorious island. Trump laid into Noah on Truth Social: “I’ll be sending my lawyers.”

item.title: Dan Bongino Walks Back Through the FBI-Podcaster Revolving Door
item.description: The bombastic right-wing media personality, who recently stepped down as deputy director of the federal agency, returned to his regular perch on Monday, offering his account of his role in the Epstein debacle before Donald Trump called in.
